map.根据夹层累及范围进行Stanford与DeBakey分型，评估治疗策略与风险: Classify Stanford and DeBakey types by dissection extent, assess treatment strategy and risk
map.夹层累及范围（选择最远端累及部位）: Dissection extent (select the most distal involved site)
map.高血压、脉压差增大、不对称脉搏、神经系统症状: Hypertension, widened pulse pressure, asymmetric pulses, neurologic symptoms
map.提示：Stanford分型最常用于临床决策——A型夹层是外科急症，需急诊手术修复: Note: Stanford type is most used for clinical decisions - Type A is a surgical emergency needing emergency repair; uncomplicated Type B prefers medical therapy (heart rate <60 bpm, systolic 100-120 mmHg). Complicated Type B (rupture/malperfusion/rapid expansion) needs TEVAR. For clinical reference only.
map.Stanford 分型判定：破口/夹层累及升主动脉为 A 型（无论起始部位），仅: Stanford: tear/dissection involving ascending aorta is Type A (regardless of origin), only descending distal is Type B; Type A is critical needing emergency surgery, Type B usually medical (BP control).
map.DeBakey 分型：I 型起于升主动脉累及主动脉弓及降部，II 型仅限升主动脉: DeBakey: Type I from ascending involving arch and descending, Type II limited to ascending, Type III from arch-descent distally; DeBakey I/II = Stanford A, III = B.
map.急诊分诊与预警：突发撕裂样胸背痛、血压差（双臂收缩压差 >20 mmHg）、脉搏: ER triage: sudden tearing chest/back pain, BP discrepancy (inter-arm systolic difference >20 mmHg), asymmetric pulses suggest dissection; with D-dimer and contrast CT aortography rapid stratification, Type A activates green channel immediately.
map.输入：破口位于升主动脉、累及主动脉弓、伴右臂血压高于左臂 25 mmHg。工具输: Input: tear in ascending aorta, arch involved, right arm BP 25 mmHg higher than left. Output: Stanford A (DeBakey I), risk high, principle emergency surgical replacement/stent, urgent measure control systolic 100-120 mmHg and HR <60 bpm. Note: each hour delayed raises death risk; immediate transfer.
map.Stanford A 与 B 型处理有何不同？: How do Type A and B differ in management?
map.A 型破口在升主动脉，易致主动脉破裂或心包填塞，需紧急外科手术；B 型破口在降主: Type A tear in ascending aorta risks rupture or tamponade, needs emergency surgery; Type B tear in descending, if asymptomatic or uncomplicated can be medically controlled, endovascular repair only if expansion/rupture/ischemia. Typing by imaging (CT/MRI).
map.为什么夹层要严格控制血压和心率？: Why strict BP and HR control in dissection?
map.降低左心室收缩速率（dp/dt）与收缩压可减小主动脉壁剪切力，延缓夹层扩展。目标: Lowering LV contractility (dp/dt) and systolic BP reduces aortic wall shear and slows extension. Target mostly systolic 100-120 mmHg, HR <60 bpm (beta-blocker first for pain, then vasodilators), individualized under monitoring.
map.未控制的高血压、马凡综合征等结缔组织病、主动脉瓣二叶畸形、主动脉瘤病史、孕期与医: Uncontrolled hypertension, Marfan and connective tissue disease, bicuspid aortic valve, aortic aneurysm history, pregnancy and iatrogenic catheter operators are high-risk. Sudden severe chest/back pain must not be delayed - call emergency and lie flat still.
map.主动脉夹层Stanford/DeBakey分型器，根据夹层累及范围进行分型并给出: Aortic dissection Stanford/DeBakey classifier - types by dissection extent and gives treatment strategy, aiding acute aortic syndrome assessment.
map.依据国际/中国心血管指南与公开公式标准（ESC/ACC/AHA 等）逐项计算: Calculations follow international/Chinese cardiovascular guidelines and published formulas (ESC/ACC/AHA, etc.)
map.实时输出风险分层、关键截断值与分级: Outputs risk stratification, key thresholds and grading in real time
map.输入数值可复核，过程透明可追溯: Inputs are verifiable, the process is transparent and traceable
map.数据本地处理，不上传服务器: Data processed locally, not uploaded to server
